Viewport Preview
Viewport Preview

The viewport shows a map's map pieces and assets, lit by the selected GPARAM including its unsaved edits. Switch the viewport to Game render mode to see the lighting. Time of day, weather and other lighting settings are in the Viewport Rendering section.
Maps can't be shown. This needs the Map Editor enabled for this project, readable maps and the Vulkan renderer.

Map
Pick a map to show the selected GPARAM on. Double-click a map to load it.
Actions
Load, frame or unload the map shown in the viewport.
Load GPARAM's Map
Load the map the selected GPARAM belongs to.
Load Picked Map
Load the map picked in the list above.
Frame Map
Move the camera so the whole map is in view.
Unload Map
Remove the map from the viewport.
Options
How the map is chosen and loaded.
Load the GPARAM's map when it is selected
When a map's GPARAM is selected, load its map into the viewport.
Load assets
Show the map's assets (objects) as well as its map pieces. Applies the next time a map loads.
Time of Day
The viewport uses the Map Editor's time of day and weather, set in the Map Lighting tab of the Viewport Rendering section, so both editors light a map the same way.
Follow the selected value's time
When you select a value of a field that changes through the day, light the viewport at that value's time of day instead of the Map Editor's.
